author: Kevin Kelly
short: Music, community tools, leveling, logging, and message transformations for Red.
description: Custom Red Discord Bot cogs: AudioPlus, CommunityPlus, LevelPlus, LogPlus, and OwoPlus. See the repository README and individual cog guides for setup, commands, permissions, and data storage.
install_msg: Thanks for adding Kevin Cogs. List the available cogs with [p]cog list kevin-cogs, or use your chosen repository name. Setup guides: https://github.com/kevinwaynekelly/kevin-cogs. AudioPlus requires a running Lavalink v4 node.
